overall_diagnosis: All samples converge on a single root cause: reflow-profile-compliance-toolkit/SKILL.md has ambiguous or incorrect instructions for (1) the required deliverables/task-completion conditions (q01–q05 JSON outputs and strict schema/format rules) and (2) Q02 time-above-liquidus (TAL) computation, specifically the deterministic selection of the representative/worst-case thermocouple per run. Other inventory items are contextual or supportive and are not primary repair targets for this task.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The skill underspecifies or misstates the task’s completion requirements and deliverable constraints (generation of all mandated q01.json–q05.json files, exact schemas, ordering/sorting, rounding, null/missing handling, and error/fallback behavior). It also provides incorrect or incomplete logic for Q02 TAL reporting by failing to deterministically select the handbook-defined representative/worst-case/cold-spot thermocouple, leading to inconsistent or wrong TAL/compliance outputs when multiple TCs exist per run.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Amend the skill in two places. (A) Deliverables/task completion: explicitly enumerate q01–q05 required JSON artifacts, their exact schemas/fields, required sorting/grouping keys, rounding conventions, units, deterministic null/missing-data handling, and what to output when a run cannot be computed; add a checklist-style completion gate that fails if any file is missing or schema-invalid. (B) Q02 TAL & representative TC selection: define a handbook-grounded, deterministic per-run TC selection procedure (e.g., choose worst-case/cold-spot TC as defined by handbook; if handbook is silent, default to the TC with maximum TAL or maximum peak/longest time above threshold—whichever the task specifies—then apply deterministic tie-breakers such as lowest TC id/name lexicographic). Make the guidance clearly separate (i) per-TC metric computation from (ii) the single representative-TC metric reported for the run, and require consistent use of the selected TC for TAL value and compliance status.
